Does the middle of the green line sit on that ruler, or is it pushed off it by several times the line's own thickness? Answer yes if the green line sits on the straight join (it is straight); answer no if its middle is clearly pushed off (it is bowed). Answer yes or no only.

Answer yes if the edge lines are pushed off (bowed); answer no if they sit on the straight join (straight). Answer yes or no only.
